description.value: Bimini's Since 1975 is a Kitsilano institution recognized as British Columbia's first neighbourhood pub, operating since 1974 at 2010 West 4th Avenue. Recently renovated under new ownership, the three-floor, 294-capacity venue blends heritage elements — reclaimed wood from a historic Vancouver mill, imported tiles — with a modern sports bar boasting 16 screens and 24 craft beers on tap. It serves as the official pub partner of Vancouver Whitecaps FC and hosts live music, DJ nights, trivia, and special events, making it a lively stop on the West 4th corridor.
